• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Java Backend Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Java Backend Developer, you will make a significant contribution to enterprise application development, system architecture, and software reliability by collaborating closely with cross-functional development teams. The Java Backend developer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of modern Java frameworks and tools in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and operations teams, building and maintaining robust multi-module enterprise applications that deliver high performance and scalability.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Development of new features and maintenance of existing Java applications;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Participation in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering to development and testing;
  • Perform code reviews and maintain code quality standards.


Essential Skills

  • Proficiency with object-oriented software development in Java;
  • Experience with Spring Framework;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Extensive experience with Hibernate/JPA for ORM.



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge of agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito);
  • JVM tuning and performance optimization skills.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Operador de NOC Pleno
description:
Na RÓDIO TECH, buscamos excelência operacional e inovação constante. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais excepcionais, comprometidos com padrões de qualidade globais e soluções que impactam positivamente nossos clientes em todo o mundo.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em NOC, Service Desk, suporte técnico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário em: Monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus ou similares)
  • Execução de jobs e rotinas (Control-M, Rundeck, Jenkins ou similares) Redes (DNS, HTTP, ping, traceroute, portas, latência).
  • Sistemas operacionais (Windows Server e/ou Linux).
  • Capacidade de interpretação de alertas e priorização de eventos. Boa comunicação para registro de chamados e acionamento de equipes.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e organização na execução de procedimentos.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escalas 24x7 (quando aplicável). Desejável: Vivência com ITIL / processos de gerenciamento de incidentes.
  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Experiência com scripts básicos (Shell, PowerShell ou Python).


Responsabilidades


  • Monitorar servidores, aplicações, serviços e componentes de infraestrutura em tempo real. Tratar alertas e eventos gerados em plataformas como Zabbix, analisando impacto e prioridade.
  • Acompanhar, validar e apoiar execuções de jobs no Control-M (ou ferramentas similares). Realizar abertura, classificação e registro de incidentes em sistemas ITSM.
  • Acionar equipes internas e externas conforme matrizes de escalonamento.
  • Atualizar dashboards, painéis de monitoramento e relatórios operacionais.
  • Executar triagem inicial de incidentes, coletando evidências e contribuindo para a análise técnica. Seguir e executar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs).
  • Manter registros completos e documentação clara sobre ocorrências, evidências e ações executadas.


Modelo de contratação :


Contrato: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).


Modelo de atuação:


  • Modelo: 100% Remoto


Na RÓDIO TECH, conectamos os melhores profissionais às melhores vagas. Se você se identifica com esse perfil e busca uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa que valoriza o talento e a inovação, inscreva-se agora mesmo!

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor de SAP sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em parceria com um cliente de grande porte, em projetos estratégicos e relevantes, com foco em transformação digital e modernização de processos financeiros em ambiente SAP S/4HANA . O projeto terá início previsto para 19/01/2026 , com tempo de contrato de 6 meses e possibilidade de extensão, atuando em iniciativas voltadas a incorporação societária (M&A).


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Consultor(a) SAP FI Sênior em ambiente SAP S/4HANA
  • Participar de projetos de incorporação societária (M&A)
  • Configurar, acompanhar e dar suporte aos processos financeiros no SAP FI
  • Interface com áreas de negócio e times técnicos
  • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas SAP e qualidade das entregas

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação acadêmica obrigatória
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em SAP FI
  • Conhecimento consolidado em SAP S/4HANA
  • Atuação prévia em projetos SAP FI

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência em projetos de incorporação societária (M&A)
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade de interação com stakeholders
  • Organização, autonomia e gestão do tempo
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e resiliente

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 56141


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Desenvolvedor Full Stack venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack experiente para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações do time utilizando as principais tecnologias do mercado. Nossa principal aplicação, FTS de Crédito, é um sistema que conecta os canais do banco e é a porta de entrada para as operações de crédito e garantias, incluindo empréstimos, fianças, compras de dívida e carteiras. Atuamos em diversos países, como Chile, Luxemburgo, México, e estamos expandindo para Estados Unidos e Peru. Nosso desafio é manter o sistema estável enquanto modernizamos a tecnologia e ampliamos a atuação internacional. Responsabilidades Desenvolver e manter aplicações front-end utilizando Angular (versões recentes) Criar e evoluir APIs e serviços back-end com Node.js e .NET Projetar e implementar soluções de banco de dados SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB/DocumentDB) Participar de todas as fases do desenvolvimento, desde a concepção até o deploy Garantir a qualidade do código através de testes e boas práticas Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente ágil Realizar code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core e Node ,conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20)

Experiência com bancos de dados PostgreSQL Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB e/ou DocumentDB)

Versionamento de código com Git Conhecimento em TypeScript Ingles intermediario

Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com NestJS Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços Conhecimento em arquitetura de microfrontend Familiaridade com Docker e containerização Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD RxJS e programação reativa Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, xUnit) Conhecimento em padrões de projeto Diferenciais Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS) Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps


Modelo Remoto

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Arquiteto de Sistemas e Infraestrutura
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) ARQUITETO DE SISTEMAS/INFRAESTRUTURA com experiência em criar ambientes/pipeline devops, com foco na construção de experiências consistentes e centradas no usuário.


Responsabilidades:


1. Planejamento e Design:


  • Definir a arquitetura de sistemas (aplicações, integrações, APIs) alinhada às necessidades do negócio;
  • Projetar a infraestrutura (rede, servidores, storage, cloud) garantindo alta disponibilidade e desempenho;
  • Escolher padrões e tecnologias adequadas (on-premises, cloud, híbrido).


2. Governança e Segurança:


  • Garantir conformidade com normas (LGPD, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS);
  • Definir políticas de segurança para aplicações e infraestrutura;
  • Implementar estratégias de backup, disaster recovery e continuidade de negócio.


3. Integração e Escalabilidade:


  • Planejar integração entre sistemas internos e externos;
  • Garantir escalabilidade horizontal e vertical para suportar crescimento;
  • Avaliar trade-offs entre custo, performance e complexidade.


4. Automação e Eficiência:


  • Implementar práticas de Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Automatizar processos de deploy, monitoramento e gestão de recursos;
  • Otimizar custos em ambientes cloud e on-premises.


5. Monitoramento e Suporte:


  • Definir estratégias de observabilidade (logs, métricas, alertas);
  • Garantir SLA e SLO para serviços críticos;
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e operações com troubleshooting avançado.


6. Liderança e Comunicação:


  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Documentar arquitetura e padrões para equipes;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores e engenheiros sobre boas práticas.


Requisitos:


  • Sistemas;
  • Arquitetura de Software: Padrões (Microservices, SOA, Event-driven), princípios SOLID;
  • Integração de Sistemas: APIs REST/GraphQL, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Modelagem e Documentação: UML, C4 Model, diagramas de arquitetura;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Azure, GCP; arquiteturas híbridas e multi-cloud;
  • Banco de Dados: SQL, NoSQL, modelagem, replicação e tuning;
  • Segurança de Aplicações: OAuth2, JWT, criptografia, compliance (LGPD, ISO).

title: Salesforce Apex Developer
description:
Salesforce Apex Developer

Location : Brazil

We are looking a seasoned Salesforce engineer, who designs, develops, and optimizes secure, scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL/SOSL.

Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and unit-test Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueables, schedulables, and platform events in multi-org environments.

· Build modern UIs with LWC/Aura, integrating with server-side Apex and Salesforce Data APIs.

· Implement secure, compliant solutions (field-level security, sharing model, FLS/CRUD checks, with platform encryption where applicable).

· Own integration patterns (REST/SOAP, callouts, Platform Events, Change Data Capture) and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft/Boomi/Informatica) as needed.

· Optimize performance (selective queries, bulkification, governor limits, transaction control) and improve org health via code reviews and static analysis.

· Define CI/CD pipelines (Copado/AutoRABIT/GitHub Actions), branching strategies, and automated testing (Apex tests, Jest for LWC).

· Collaborate in Scrum/Agile ceremonies, estimate work, and deliver increments; provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

· Document solution designs, sequence/data models, and deployment runbooks; support UAT and production releases with high reliability.

Requirements

· Experience in Salesforce development; strong Apex expertise designing enterprise-grade solutions.

· Hands-on with LWC, Aura, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Data Service, and Salesforce Security/sharing model.

· Experience with integration (REST/SOAP/Webhooks), middleware and eventing

· Proficiency with DevOps/CI-CD on Salesforce (Copado/AutoRABIT/Git), test automation, code quality tools (PMD, ESLint for LWC).

· Solid understanding of governor limits, bulk patterns, transaction control, and performance tuning at scale.

· Experience working in agile teams; strong communication skills in English (C1) to work with global stakeholders.

· Preferred: Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I), experience with Heroku, SSO/Security, and Unit/E2E testing frameworks

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Full Stack
description:
Quem somos:

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.

Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.


Requisito da vaga



Hard Skills:

  • C# e .NET Core;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful com ASP.NET Core;
  • Aplicação de arquiteturas como Clean, em camadas e DDD;
  • Padrões de projeto GoF e distribuídos;
  • EF Core, SQL e bancos relacionais/NoSQL;
  • Criação e implantação de microsserviços com Docker;
  • Prática em TDD e testes unitários;
  • Controle de versão com Git e uso de Git Flow;
  • Experiência com IA e Produtos financeiros.



Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Dinamismo;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.



Diferenciais:

  • Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Mensageria (RabbitMQ e Kafka);
  • Pipelines CI/CD e segurança (JWT, OAuth e OpenID);
  • Conhecimento em front-end com frameworks modernos.




O que nós oferecemos:

  • Descontos nas Universidades FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta e Full Cycle;
  • Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês;
  • Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações;
  • Apoio para participação em eventos de TI;
  • Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub;
  • Acesso à Onhappy, plataforma exclusiva que oferece descontos em passagens aéreas e hospedagens.

title: JavaScript Fullstack
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work with a high skilled team to leverage complex and high quality machine learning and statistical models;
  • Implement model to service integration via DAG creations and ETL processes;
  • Evaluate model performance under real data testing results and remodelate accordingly;
  • Build scalable models and DAGs to enable new workflows creations in a high-usage, high-demand environment;
  • Work with worldwide multidisciplinary distributed team, participate in technical discussions and definitions using English as main communication language;
  • Leverage accurate model architecture and documentation.


Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related areas;
  • Desire to combine theory and abilities to solve problems pragmatically, applying Machine Learning techniques and integrating them into larger systems;
  • Desire to work with product managers and software engineers, translating requirements into design and models into end-to-end production code;
  • Knowledge in probability and statistical modeling;
  • Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and Machine Learning modeling using Python;
  • Hands-on experience on model evaluation, integration, data transformation and deployment, covering the complete end-to-end cycle;
  • Knowledge in SQL and relational databases;
  • Knowledge with DAG definition and implementation.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Python notebooks, pandas;
  • Experience with PySpark, Airflow;
  • Experience with cloud tools (AWS, Azure, GCP) and orchestration tools;
  • Knowledge about model life cycle, data drift and model drift;
  • Experience with data structures;
  • Experience with finops data treatment and cost saving analysis.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: .NET/C# - React (Fullstack)
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.


Essential Skills

  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development.

title: Academic Writing Intern-PhD in Computer Engineering
description:
Job Description

We are seeking researchers and editors capable of providing in-depth assessments of academic manuscripts (similar to journal peer reviews).


Content Development

Leverage scientific expertise to write, proofread, and fact-check data under the guidance of subject matter leads. Develop high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials—including slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meeting materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content—while ensuring meticulous attention to detail.


Manuscript Polishing

  • Language Enhancement : Optimize academic and scientific texts to meet standard scientific English conventions. Improve grammar, punctuation, clarity, conciseness, and logical flow while preserving the author’s intended meaning. Ensure the language is suitable for a global academic audience and aligns with formal scientific writing standards.
  • Formatting Adjustments : Adapt manuscripts to journal-specific requirements, implementing guidelines related to structure, layout, reference formatting, abbreviations, units of measure, and other stylistic elements. Ensure consistency across the main text, tables, figures, and supplementary materials based on internal style guides or individual journal criteria.
  • Document Metadata Verification : Use specialized software to cross-verify references and other metadata. Review in-text citations, reference lists, author affiliations, figure/table labels, and other bibliographic details to ensure accuracy and completeness of academic referencing.


Qualifications

  • Experience as an invited peer reviewer for journals or as a journal editor (mandatory).
  • Published academic papers as first author or corresponding author (mandatory).
  • PhD/MD in Engineering with PhD or a related field.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Location: Remote (Latin America)

Working Schedule: Part-time to start, with flexibility. Ideal overlap of ~6 hours with Pacific Time (9am–3pm PT)

Compensation: $21–$24 USD/hour · Part-time (up to 6 hours per day )


Overview

We’re hiring an Accounting Manager to support a portfolio of CPG industry clients , including an upcoming engagement with e-commerce channels (Shopify, Amazon) . This person will own the day-to-day accounting and independently run month-end close , allowing the CFO to focus on higher-level client work and growth.


Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end close process for CPG/e-commerce clients.
  • Perform inventory reconciliations and full balance sheet reconciliations .
  • Reconcile cash clearing accounts for Shopify, Amazon, and other processors (e.g., Stripe , Walmart marketplace, etc.).
  • Manage trade spend accruals and customer invoice deductions , including categorizing deductions by type in the general ledger (e.g., distributor and retailer deductions from customers such as UNFI, KEHE).
  • Handle credit card reconciliations and ensure accurate cash activity reporting.
  • Manage accrual-basis accounting , including accruals, prepaids (prepaid schedules + amortization), and (as applicable) fixed assets .
  • Support operational AR/AP activities (invoice entry, bill processing, applying payments), with a focus on clean workflows and accuracy.
  • Maintain clean, audit-ready books and support basic technical accounting needs tied to CPG operations.


Requirements — Must-Have

  • 4–5+ years of progressive accounting experience (able to operate independently).
  • Strong experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) + Bill.com + Excel skills
  • Experience supporting Manufacturing and/or CPG companies , with strong exposure to inventory-based accounting.
  • Solid understanding of US GAAP , accruals, and reserves.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (or closely related field).


Nice-to-Have

  • Prior people management or team lead experience (future growth: managing clerks).
  • Familiarity with Cin7 and Rippling — nice to have, not required.
  • Exposure to technical accounting topics like trade spend accruals, inventory obsolescence reserves, bad debt reserves.
  • Knowledge of ASC 842 lease accounting (ROU asset / lease accounting).

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Order Management Analyst
description:
Title: UAT Order Management Lead (LATAM)

Location: Position is 100% remote, candidates needs to be physically sit in the LATAM region

Duration: 08 Months


Key Responsibilities

• Lead or support UAT activities for Order Management processes, including test planning, execution, and defect management.

• Collaborate with business SMEs and IT teams to ensure test coverage aligns with Client’s operational requirements.

• Execute test scripts and validate system functionality against business processes.

• Provide clear documentation of test results and escalate issues for resolution.

• If required, backfill operational tasks in Order Management to maintain business continuity during project phases.

• Act as a liaison between IT and business teams, translating technical requirements into business context.

• Ensure compliance with Client’s testing standards and governance.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong Order Management process expertise (Order-to-Cash lifecycle).

• Hands-on experience with SAP Order Management modules.

• Familiarity with UAT methodologies and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, HP ALM).

• Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Highly Desirable

• Operational experience in consumer goods or manufacturing environments.

• Knowledge of Client’s regional business practices and compliance requirements.

• Local language skills and cultural awareness for effective collaboration.

• Ability to adapt between testing and operational roles as needed.

description:
VTRAC Consulting Corporation Intelligent Resources


Thank you for applying to VTRAC opportunities. Please e-mail your resume as an MS-WORD document in confidence, Subject: Senior IT Agency Recruiter (Brazil, Colombia), Attention: .


Position: Senior IT Agency Recruiters (Remote, BRAZIL, COLOMBIA)

Working hours: Eastern Times (12 pm to 9 pm or 8:30 am to 5:30 pm)

Position Type: Permanent x 2 (Base Salary + Bonus + Paid Vacation)

Locations: 100% Remote (BRAZIL), COLOMBIA (Medellin, Cartagena)


ABOUT VTRAC

VTRAC Consulting Corporation ( is a well-established Recruitment firm with a strong track record of providing quality resources in the Technology, Engineering, and management fields. VTRAC was founded in 1993 by senior technology and business professionals and supports clients in LATAM and North America.


POSITIONS

We are looking for quality-driven and assertive senior and intermediate technology recruiters with great English communication skills to work with a supportive team where personal and professional growth matters, and associated rewards and competitive compensation are accelerated only by your own desire and commitment. You will be primarily responsible for finding, deeply technically and functionally evaluating, and presenting candidates, and coordinating with clients.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify, engage, and explore candidates’ real motivation and interest, validate their skills and competencies, and present quality talents in a timely manner.
  • In-depth technical and functional evaluation and assessment of technology candidates.
  • Participate in full-cycle recruitment and staffing assignments for both contract and permanent placement opportunities, for clients in the Technology, Engineering, automotive, and Finance sectors.
  • Network, research databases, contact, source, collect, screen applications, select, examine, evaluate, and interview candidates.
  • Coordinate and notify candidates on requirements for the prospective position, job offers, contracts, terms, and conditions of employment.
  • Partner and collaborate with other recruiters through teamwork, imparting your knowledge, experience, skills, and advice on staffing policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the presentation of candidates to prospective clients.
  • Prepare reporting on activities and results.


QUALIFICATION

  • Min 4+ years of recruitment experience with a strong network, preferably in the Microsoft (service providers or users), Cloud Computing, Data, AI, Financial Services, FinTech, and Auto manufacturing organizations.
  • Min 2 years of experience in DIRECT HEADHUNTING of permanent and contract technology candidates.
  • Min 2 years of experience as an agency recruiter working directly with the hiring clients (NOT through RPO).
  • Min 2 years of sales or sales support experience
  • MUST HAVE minimum 2+ years working with U.S. or Canadian markets.
  • Must have in-depth technical evaluation experience and be able to fully assess the candidate’s skills.
  • VERY STRONG networking, relationship-building, and very active recruitment-related social media engagement activities, especially on LinkedIn.
  • Fluent English communication skills (verbal and written).
  • STRONG teamwork, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Working experience with MS Word, CRM, or ATS systems.


We thank all candidates in advance. Only selected candidates for interviews will be contacted. For other exciting opportunities, please visit us at VTRAC is an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Tech Recruiter Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Sólida experiência como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Videomaker
description:
Sobre nós:


A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis.

Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras.

Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS.

É a primeira de seu setor na Global Data Alliance junto a companhias como Panasonic, Visa, Pfizer e American Express.


Atividades:

* Criar e editar vídeos para campanhas de marketing, redes sociais, apresentações institucionais e outros formatos digitais;

* Desenvolver conceitos criativos para vídeos, alinhados com os objetivos estratégicos do time de marketing;

* Produzir conteúdos audiovisuais de alta qualidade, desde a captação até a pós-produção (edição, color grading, inserção de efeitos, áudio, etc.);

* Colaborar com o time de marketing para alinhar os vídeos às estratégias de comunicação e identidade visual da marca;

* Garantir que os prazos de entrega sejam cumpridos com qualidade e consistência;

* Acompanhar tendências de mercado e propor ideias inovadoras para formatos e abordagens de vídeo.


Requisitos da vaga:

* Experiência comprovada em criação e edição de vídeos (portfólio obrigatório);

* Domínio dos principais softwares e programas de criação e edição de vídeo atuais, como Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve e ferramentas de motion graphics (ex.: Adobe Animate, Cinema 4D ou similares);

* Conhecimento em animação gráfica, com habilidade para criar motion graphics e animações que complementem os projetos audiovisuais;

* Conhecimento em captação de vídeo, incluindo operação de câmeras, iluminação e áudio;

* Familiaridade com tendências de redes sociais e formatos de vídeo para plataformas como Instagram, YouTube, TikTok e LinkedIn;

* Criatividade, atenção aos detalhes e senso estético apurado;

* Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente;

* Experiência prévia em marketing ou produção de conteúdo audiovisual será considerada um diferencial.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (Figma, Marketing & Paid Social)
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Graphic Designer who works daily in Figma and designs high-converting landing pages, emails, and paid social ads for e-commerce brands.


Job Title: Senior Graphic Designer (Figma, Landing Pages, Email & Performance Ads)

Company: Sender Agency

Location: Remote (LATAM preferred, East Coast or Central Time overlap)

Type: Full-Time, Monday to Friday

Compensation: $1,600 to $2,500 USD per month


We’re hiring a Senior Graphic Designer who works daily in Figma and designs high-converting landing pages, emails, and paid social ads for e-commerce brands.


This role is performance-focused. You will design assets that drive clicks, conversions, and revenue across the funnel.


If you have strong taste and understand how design impacts CRO, this role is for you.

About Sender Agency


Sender Agency is a performance-focused creative agency that has spent the last seven years building and scaling e-commerce brands. We have worked with blue-chip and celebrity-backed companies including Cacti by Travis Scott, Just Water by Will Smith, Alice Mushrooms, and brands backed by Patrick Mahomes.


Our team has launched brands from zero and helped scale existing businesses past $20M in revenue. Design plays a central role in that growth. We care about how things look, but more importantly, we care about how they perform.


The Role

We are hiring a Senior Graphic Designer to own landing page design, email design, and paid advertising creative using Figma.


This is a hands-on role for a designer who understands that strong visuals support conversion and that landing pages, emails, and ads must work together as a system.


You will work closely with the founders, media buyers, and copywriters to produce creative that is visually strong, conversion-focused, and built to scale.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing conversion-focused landing pages in Figma for e-commerce brands
  • Creating email designs for Klaviyo, including flows and campaigns
  • Producing high-volume paid social ad creative for Meta and other platforms
  • Maintaining visual consistency across ads, emails, and landing pages
  • Iterating quickly using templates, systems, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Using AI tools for image generation and rapid creative iteration
  • Collaborating with founders, media buyers, and copywriters
  • Improving creative based on performance feedback such as CTR, thumb-stop rate, and conversion rate

Who You Are

  • A senior-level graphic designer with strong taste and performance instincts
  • Highly proficient in Figma, especially for landing pages and email systems
  • Experienced with conversion-focused design and CRO principles
  • Comfortable producing a high volume of work without sacrificing quality
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own workload
  • Clear and professional in written and spoken English


Bonus experience: familiarity with AI-driven creative workflows, basic copywriting instincts, and understanding of Meta ad performance metrics


Why You’ll Like Working Here


Sender Agency operates with a flat team structure. Strong ideas are encouraged regardless of role or title. You will work directly with the founders and be trusted to take ownership of your work.

We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and follow through. This is a results-driven environment with a strong creative culture and high standards.


About the Founders

Richard – Worked on the global marketing team at Levi’s and led creative and content at Chubbies. Background in brand and storytelling at a high level.

Alan – Career in VC-backed media and tech companies. Has helped build, scale, and exit multiple businesses.


Together, they bring a balance of brand thinking and performance execution.


Role Details

  • Full-time, Monday through Friday
  • Working hours aligned with East Coast or Central Time
  • Fully remote, with preference for candidates based in Latin America
  • Long-term role with real ownership


Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid test task to ensure alignment on quality, speed, and performance thinking.



Final Note


This role is demanding, but it offers real ownership and meaningful impact. You will not just be designing assets. You will be contributing directly to how brands grow and perform.

If you are a senior designer who cares about results and wants to work closely with a high-caliber team, we would like to hear from you.


— Richard Tubman

  • Sender Agency

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.
